prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply retrieval augmented generation expertise to this task". The fixture contains version/runtime ambiguity, a tempting shortcut, a compatibility edge case, and a failure path that distinguishes real expertise from generic completion. The acceptance boundary is rag-retrieval-systems: Define source authority, document lifecycle, parsing, chunk identity, metadata, access control, retrieval stages, reranking, context assembly, citation mapping, and stale/deleted content behavior. The adjacent prompt-context-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: manual corpus with headings, troubleshooting tables, exact error/part identifiers, paraphrased symptoms and duplicate/superseded revisions
configurable parser/chunker plus lexical/semantic candidate retrieval and a fusion/reranking stage
versioned relevance judgments with exact-match, semantic, stale-revision and no-answer query classes
citation checker that resolves source revision, page/section and chunk locator plus retrieval latency traces
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual rag-retrieval-systems boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=llm-application-engineering; near-neighbor=prompt-context-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define source authority, document lifecycle, parsing, chunk identity, metadata, access control, retrieval stages, reranking, context assembly, citation mapping, and stale/deleted content behavior.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Use question sets with known source evidence to measure retrieval recall, answer groundedness, citation correctness, abstention on missing evidence, authorization filtering, freshness, and latency across corpus/index/model revisions.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not optimize chunk size from intuition alone, cite documents the model did not actually use, return inaccessible content through retrieval, or treat vector similarity as sufficient relevance.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Corpus/source/revision, parser/chunker, embedding/index and retrieval-configuration identity; Authorization/filtering plus stale/deleted/missing-content behavior; Candidate/fusion/reranking and source-to-chunk-to-citation lineage; Versioned retrieval query judgments with Recall/Precision/MRR/NDCG and latency evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
